content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. But we could also get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. However we need the compound identity. Perhaps the system expects we use IR spectra tool to detect C=O stretch. That would give peaks around 1700 cm-1. The IR spectra string may include description. Let's call ir_spectra.
